name: The Long Thaw
author: Fidgetfall
description: An original 17-character script for 8-13 players. The snow is going off the mountain and something that was under it is not. Built for tables where claims are addressed rather than broadcast: several characters read the public record — who claimed what to whom, who voted which way — instead of reading the grimoire, so comparing notes out loud is worth more here than anywhere.

name: Ledgerkeeper
ability: You start knowing two players. Exactly one of them is evil.
firstNightReminder: Point to two players, exactly one of whom is evil.

name: Roofwalker
ability: Each night*, choose a player: you learn whether they are the same alignment as you.
otherNightReminder: The Roofwalker points to a player. Nod if that player shares their alignment; shake your head if not.

name: Thawwarden
ability: Each night*, choose a player other than yourself: they cannot die tonight.
otherNightReminder: The Thawwarden points to a player. Mark that player Sheltered until dawn.

name: Bellringer
ability: Each night*, if a player died in the night, you learn whether they were good.
otherNightReminder: If anyone died tonight, show the Bellringer a thumbs up if they were good, thumbs down if evil.

name: Chandler
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: you learn how many different characters they have claimed to be, to anyone.

name: Reckoner
ability: Each night*, you learn how many evil players voted to execute today.
otherNightReminder: Show the Reckoner the number of evil players who voted yes on any nomination today.

name: Cairnwright
ability: If you die at night, you are woken before dawn and learn one player's character.
otherNightReminder: If the Cairnwright died tonight, wake them, let them point to a player, and show that player's character token.

name: Stormglass
ability: You start knowing two characters. One of them is in play and one is not. You are not told which is which.
firstNightReminder: Show two character tokens: one in play, one not.

name: Sleeper
ability: You do not know that you are the Sleeper. You think you are a Townsfolk, but every piece of information you are given is false.

name: Hollow
ability: If you are executed, your team loses.

name: Echo
ability: You may register as evil, and as a Minion or a Demon, to any ability - even after you die.

name: Frostbite
ability: Each night, choose a player: their ability does not work tonight or tomorrow.
firstNightReminder: The Frostbite points to a player. Mark them Frozen.
otherNightReminder: The Frostbite points to a player. Mark them Frozen.

name: Quarryman
ability: There are two extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]

name: Wintermouth
ability: Each night, choose a player. Tomorrow the Storyteller announces to the whole town that this player was seen speaking privately with the Demon. It may be true. It is usually not.
firstNightReminder: The Wintermouth points to a player. Announce them in the morning as seen with the Demon.
otherNightReminder: The Wintermouth points to a player. Announce them in the morning as seen with the Demon.

name: The Thaw
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If nobody died in the night before, you may choose two players instead.
otherNightReminder: The Thaw points to a player, or to two players if nobody died last night. They die.

name: The Hollowing
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If they had publicly claimed a character, you learn one good character that is not in play.
otherNightReminder: The Hollowing points to a player. They die. If that player had publicly claimed a character, show one good character token that is not in play.
